title: eriosorus insignis
intro: Eriosorus insignis, commonly known as the Insignis Bur Marigold, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as a diuretic, helping to relieve symptoms of urinary tract issues. The therapeutic actions of Eriosorus insignis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties, but further research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
